parsed_json.up: Select compounds tested against the human glucocorticoid receptor with IC50 activities. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, compound_records, and compound_structures. Filter for target name 'glucocorticoid receptor' and organism 'Homo sapiens', standard_type 'IC50', and require canonical_smiles to be present and pubmed_id_or_doi to be present. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
